title: From Pollution to Solution: A Global Assessment of Marine Litter and Plastic Pollution
claim: UNEP's global assessment finds a growing threat from marine litter and plastic pollution across all ecosystems from source to sea, with direct impacts on marine life and coastal ecosystem health, underscoring the need for monitoring and source-reduction action in affected coastal zones.
evidence_text: UNEP's 'From Pollution to Solution' assessment documents the growing threat of marine litter and plastic pollution across all ecosystems from source to sea, providing a comprehensive update on direct impacts on marine life, risks to ecosystems and human health, and the social and economic costs involved. The assessment reviews existing solutions and actions, supporting the case for coastal and mangrove-adjacent zones under plastic or solid-waste pressure to be prioritised for monitoring and pollution-reduction measures.
